title: Abyssal Battle | Kuldra's End Ep 2 | Runescape: Dragonwilds 1.0
author: Questboard Games
description:
Buckle up! Episode 2 is here and its an eventful one! A quick tour of the swamp turns into a deadly skirmish and I got a good reminder of what happens when you're not prepared! After the fight we dive headfirst into the next zone and get some very meaningful upgrades!
